title: Youth Academy
subtitle: Premium U16 development programme for riders aged 12–16.
readOnly: Premium is inactive. Your academy history and riders are preserved, but management is read-only.
comingSoon: Coming in the next Youth Academy phase

premium.title: Premium Youth Academy
premium.description: Youth Academy is a Premium-only development layer. Premium members can optionally activate an U16 academy with a fixed 16-rider capacity.
premium.staff: Average Youth Academy Director + U16 Head Coach included
premium.scouting: Optional Youth Scout with budget-based scouting range

activation.title: Activate Youth Academy
activation.description: Activation creates your separate U16 academy. You start with six local riders, an average Youth Academy Director and U16 Head Coach. Youth Scout is optional. V1 has no infrastructure requirement.
activation.budgetHelp: This budget funds rider support, staff, scouting, equipment, camps, travel and youth competition costs.

overview.fixedCapacity: Fixed Premium capacity — independent of infrastructure
overview.directorReady: {{name}} is responsible for the Academy programme, operating requests and budget recommendations.

riders.title: Youth Riders
riders.potentialNote: Exact Potential is intentionally hidden. Assessment bands become more reliable as scouting and development information improves.

staff.scoutOptional: Youth Scout is optional. Hire one from Staff to begin active prospect discovery.

budget.title: Season Academy budget
budget.scoutingHelp: {{range}} scouting programme cost. Scouting reach is controlled by budget, not infrastructure.

scouting.title: Youth scouting range
scouting.description: Choose where the Youth Scout may search. Scout quality determines how many prospects are found and how useful the assessments are; budget only determines geographic reach.
scouting.skillNote: A Worldwide programme does not guarantee elite prospects. It only gives the scout permission to search globally.
scouting.qualityExplainer: Budget determines where the scout can search. Scout quality determines how many riders are reported, how accurately they are assessed and how effectively stronger prospects are identified.
scouting.noScout: Hire a Youth Scout to begin active monthly prospect discovery. The Academy can operate without one, but no new scout reports will be generated.
scouting.cycleCompleted: {{count}} scouting report(s) delivered this game month. The next cycle opens next game month.
scouting.cycleReady: This month's scouting cycle is ready.
scouting.directorModeHelp: The Director shortlists prospects that meet your safeguards. If negotiations are also delegated, the Director may submit offers automatically within those limits.
scouting.managerModeHelp: You review every report and decide which prospects receive an offer.
scouting.autoRuleSummary: Auto-recruit from {{band}} · max {{stipend}}/week · max compensation {{compensation}} · keep {{slots}} free slot(s).
scouting.noReportsHelp: Run the monthly scouting cycle after hiring a Youth Scout. Reports expire after 60 game days.
scouting.offerHelp: The rider and family consider location, accommodation, staff quality and the support package. An AI Academy can also accept or reject the proposed development compensation.

offerStatusHelp.academy_rejected: Increase the development compensation if you want to try again.
offerStatusHelp.rider_rejected: You can improve the stipend or accommodation package and try again.
offerStatusHelp.accepted: The rider has joined your Youth Academy.

incoming.title: Incoming Academy approaches
incoming.noneHelp: Other Premium academies can approach your Youth Riders directly. Offers waiting for your decision will appear here.
incoming.decisionHelp: Accepting the Academy offer allows the rider and family to make the final relocation decision. Declining keeps the rider in your Academy.

settings.title: Responsibilities
settings.description: Choose who handles routine Youth Academy decisions. The manager can always change these responsibilities later.
settings.autoRecruitmentDescription: These limits apply only when recruitment is delegated to the Youth Academy Director. Automatic offers require negotiations to be delegated as well.

placeholders.calendar: The separate U16 calendar and lightweight race engine will be connected in the next implementation phase. Youth race entry costs will remain mainly travel/logistics costs.
placeholders.rankings: Regional Youth Ranking and Youth World Ranking foundation will be connected with the U16 race calendar.
placeholders.equipment: Youth Academy will own separate equipment, reusing a curated lower-cost subset of the existing equipment catalogue and images.
placeholders.history: Academy graduates, youth results and long-term development history will remain attached to riders after graduation.

errors.save: Could not save Youth Academy settings.
errors.scoutingLoad: Could not load Youth scouting reports.
errors.scoutingRun: Could not run the monthly Youth scouting cycle.
errors.recruitmentOffer: Could not submit the Youth recruitment offer.
errors.incomingOffer: Could not respond to the incoming Youth Academy offer.
